one_line: Captain Thomas Best and Emperor Jahangir, facing the Portuguese at the Swally anchorage near Surat in 1612.

appearance.age_look: Best appears as a broad-shouldered Englishman in his mid-30s; Jahangir appears as a slender Mughal emperor in his early 40s with poised, regal bearing.
appearance.face: Best has a square face, light sunburned complexion, straight nose, trimmed brown moustache and short beard, with determined grey eyes and a focused, slightly stern expression; Jahangir has an oval face, light brown complexion, fine arched brows, sharp nose, neatly lined dark moustache with a small pointed beard, soft but observant brown eyes and a calm, assessing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Best’s medium-brown hair is wavy, kept just above the collar, neatly combed back under a black felt broad-brimmed hat with a narrow dark red hatband; Jahangir’s dark hair is mostly covered under a tall Mughal turban of pale gold fabric with fine green stripes, wrapped close and topped with a small jewelled ornament and a white heron feather.
appearance.costume: Best wears early-17th-century English seafaring dress: a dark navy wool doublet with narrow vertical padding and brass buttons, modest shoulder wings and long fitted sleeves ending in simple white linen cuffs, over a plain white linen shirt with a small standing collar, a dark reddish-brown leather cross-belt and broad belt with a brass buckle, knee-length dull-olive woolen breeches slightly puffed at the hips, thick grey wool hose and sturdy dark-brown leather shoes; over this he has a practical dark brown leather jerkin reinforced with subtle stitching and a simple short dark blue cloak hanging from one shoulder, all slightly weathered from sea use. Jahangir wears full Mughal court attire: a long, calf-length jama (cross-tied robe) of fine light-cream silk with a delicate all-over floral pattern in muted green and soft gold, fitted at the torso and flaring gently, fastened with a sash; the sash is a rich deep green silk patka with woven gold edge, knotted at his left hip with one end hanging down, over loose, straight cream churidar trousers; on his upper body he has a sleeveless, waist-length, lightweight vest of pale green brocade with subtle gold motifs, and on his feet soft red-brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; his jewellery is dignified but not excessive—a single medium-length gold necklace with small pearls, a narrow gold armband on his right upper arm partly visible under the sleeve, and one jade-and-gold ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: Best’s signature prop is a rolled parchment sea chart bound with a thin red cord held in his left hand, while a plain brass-hilted cutlass in a dark brown leather scabbard hangs at his left hip; Jahangir’s signature prop is a slender, straight Mughal sword (shamshir) in a richly tooled dark green leather scabbard with gold fittings, carried at his left side, and in his right hand he holds a small, ornate, pale-jade handled fly-whisk with a white horsehair tuft symbolising royal authority.

ref_desc: Thomas Best has a sunburned square face, wavy brown hair under a black hat, navy doublet and olive breeches with a leather jerkin and cutlass, beside Jahangir with light-brown oval face, pale-gold striped turban, cream floral jama, green sash, jade-handled fly-whisk and shamshir in green scabbard, all in navy, brown, cream, pale gold and deep green tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet showing two consistent characters side by side: Thomas Best and Emperor Jahangir at the Swally anchorage in 1612. Thomas Best is a broad-shouldered Englishman in his mid-30s with a sunburned square face, trimmed brown moustache and short beard, determined grey eyes, and wavy medium-brown hair just above the collar under a black felt broad-brimmed hat with a dark red hatband. He wears an early-17th-century English seafaring outfit: a dark navy wool doublet with narrow vertical padding, modest shoulder wings and brass buttons over a plain white linen shirt with a small standing collar and simple cuffs, a dark reddish-brown leather cross-belt and broad belt with brass buckle, knee-length dull-olive wool breeches slightly puffed at the hips, grey wool hose and sturdy dark-brown leather shoes, plus a practical dark brown leather jerkin and a short dark blue cloak hanging from one shoulder, all slightly weathered from sea use. His signature prop is a rolled parchment sea chart bound with a thin red cord held in his left hand, with a plain brass-hilted cutlass in a dark brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt at the left hip. Beside him, draw Jahangir as a slender Mughal emperor in his early 40s with an oval light-brown face, fine arched brows, sharp nose, neat dark moustache and small pointed beard, calm observant brown eyes and a composed half-smile; his dark hair is mostly covered by a tall pale-gold Mughal turban with fine green stripes, wrapped close and topped with a small jewelled ornament and a white heron feather. He wears a calf-length cream silk jama with delicate muted green and soft gold floral patterns, fitted at the torso and flaring slightly, tied with a deep green silk patka with gold-edged border knotted at his left hip, over cream churidar trousers; add a sleeveless pale-green brocade vest with subtle gold motifs, red-brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, and dignified jewellery: one medium-length gold necklace with small pearls, a narrow gold armband partly visible under his sleeve, and a jade-and-gold ring on his right hand. His signature items are a slender straight shamshir in a dark green leather scabbard with gold fittings at his left side and a small ornate pale-jade handled fly-whisk with a white horsehair tuft held in his right hand. Use a harmonious palette dominated by navy blue, dark brown, cream, pale gold and deep green, and clearly show face, hair, outfits and props from head to toe for consistent redrawing.
